back_content.text: 结论：核心观点：坚持一致性是构建任何长期技能的最重要因素。
back_content.explanation: 语境揭示：And I want to stress again, as I said at the beginning, that consistency is the single most important factor in building any long-term skill.

analysis_content.text: ① 识别信号："I want to stress again" + "as I said at the beginning" = 明确重复强调信号。② 核心规律：stress/emphasize/repeat/as I mentioned = 复现标记，反复出现的名词就是核心考点。③ 验证与迁移：consistency = 核心词，single most important = 最高级强调，答案直指此词。
tips: stress again / as I said before = 重复提及信号，立刻标记后接的名词。
"single most important" = 最高级限定，答案选项中含此含义才正确。

audio.transcript: And I want to stress again, as I said at the beginning, that consistency is the single most important factor in building any long-term skill.

front_content.text: 任务：先听音频，再判断说话人回到的核心观点是什么。
front_content.task_prompt: 任务：先听音频，再判断说话人回到的核心观点是什么。

back_content.text: 结论：被反复强调的核心观点：主动倾听比被动接收信息更重要。
back_content.explanation: 语境揭示：Now let me come back to the point I raised earlier — the importance of listening actively rather than just passively receiving information.

analysis_content.text: ① 识别信号："let me come back to the point I raised earlier" = 回顾式重复信号，后接被重申的核心观点。② 核心规律：come back to / return to / revisit = 观点复现，说话人重新强调原有立场。③ 验证与迁移：active listening vs passive receiving = 对比式核心观点，答案反映 active is better。
tips: come back to / return to = 观点复现，听到立即准备记录后面的核心主张。
rather than 后方是被否定的对比项，答案选 active listening 方向。

audio.transcript: Now let me come back to the point I raised earlier — the importance of listening actively rather than just passively receiving information.

front_content.text: 任务：先听音频，再说出演讲中被反复强调的核心原则。
front_content.task_prompt: 任务：先听音频，再说出演讲中被反复强调的核心原则。

back_content.text: 结论：核心原则：数据并不能单独说明全部情况，背景始终至关重要。
back_content.explanation: 语境揭示：As I've repeatedly emphasized throughout this lecture, the data alone cannot tell the full story — context always matters.

analysis_content.text: ① 识别信号："As I've repeatedly emphasized throughout this lecture" = 最强烈的重复标记——说话人自述反复强调过。② 核心规律：repeatedly/constantly/consistently + emphasized/stressed/mentioned = 强调频率词，后接内容必是主旨观点。③ 验证与迁移：data ≠ full story；context matters = 二元对比核心观点，答案选 context。
tips: repeatedly/constantly emphasized = 最强重复信号，后面的内容直接就是核心考查点。
"the data alone" = 数据单独，alone 是条件限定词，意味着数据不够用。

audio.transcript: As I've repeatedly emphasized throughout this lecture, the data alone cannot tell the full story — context always matters.

front_content.text: 任务：先听音频，再判断说话人一再重申的核心观点是什么。
front_content.task_prompt: 任务：先听音频，再判断说话人一再重申的核心观点是什么。

back_content.text: 结论：核心观点：没有明确目标，无论付出多少努力都不会产生有意义的结果。
back_content.explanation: 语境揭示：This is something I keep saying and I'll say it again: without clear goals, no amount of effort will produce meaningful results.

analysis_content.text: ① 识别信号："I keep saying and I'll say it again" = 双重强调，first person 重复标记。② 核心规律：I keep saying / I always say / I've said this before = 自述重复信号，后接的就是说话人的核心主张。③ 验证与迁移：without clear goals = 条件限定；no meaningful results = 结论，答案要完整反映条件+结果。
tips: I keep saying = 说话人自述反复强调，后接内容直接是答案。
no amount of effort = 再多努力也不够，是强调效果缺失的表达。

options.text: Effort is the key to achieving goals.
Clear goals are essential for meaningful results.
Results depend more on talent than effort.
Without effort, no goals can be achieved.

front_content.task_prompt: 任务：先听音频，再判断说话人认为哪一点值得重复强调。

back_content.text: 结论：值得重申：睡眠与认知表现的关系不只是相关性，而是因果关系。
back_content.explanation: 语境揭示：I think it bears repeating: the relationship between sleep and cognitive performance is not merely correlational, it is causal.

analysis_content.text: ① 识别信号："it bears repeating" = 值得重复强调的信号短语，后接说话人认为最重要的论断。② 核心规律：bear repeating / worth emphasizing / important to note again = 隐式重复信号，CET4 讲座型考题高频。③ 验证与迁移：not merely correlational but causal = 因果关系比相关关系更强，答案选 causal relationship。
tips: it bears repeating = 值得重申，后接的是该段最重要的论断。
not merely...but = 不仅...而且，后半句才是说话人真正想强调的。

audio.transcript: I think it bears repeating: the relationship between sleep and cognitive performance is not merely correlational, it is causal.

front_content.text: 任务：先听音频，再判断说话人最终想强调的课程核心目标是什么。
front_content.task_prompt: 任务：先听音频，再判断说话人最终想强调的课程核心目标是什么。

back_content.text: 结论：课程核心目标：培养批判性思维能力，而非灌输固定思维内容。
back_content.explanation: 语境揭示：And once more, I want you to remember: the goal of this entire course has been to teach you how to think critically, not just what to think.

analysis_content.text: ① 识别信号："And once more, I want you to remember" = 最终总结性强调，是结尾重点复习。② 核心规律：once more / one last time / I want you to remember = 结尾重复强调句型，定义课程/讲座最终核心目标。③ 验证与迁移：how to think critically（方法）vs what to think（内容）= 对比框架，答案选 critical thinking ability。
tips: once more / one last time = 结尾最终强调，最后一次复现的内容是主旨考点。
how to think 与 what to think 对比 = 方法论 vs 内容论，前者是强调目标。

audio.transcript: And once more, I want you to remember: the goal of this entire course has been to teach you how to think critically, not just what to think.
